description.value:
Frequency at will

Hold still and keep a Marked quarry in view for a full round; your next Strike against it before the end of your following turn ignores lesser and standard cover entirely (greater cover still applies) and deals an extra 1d8 precision damage (2d8 at Blooded, 3d8 at Veteran, 4d8 at Undying).

cinderfall.incomplete: Blocked on the Mark; independently, "held still and watched for a full round" isn't a trackable state (no roll option accumulates "turns spent not moving while watching a specific target"). The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
